# Junk Removal Brothers (Rochester Junk Removal Brothers)

> Family-owned, brother-operated residential and commercial junk removal serving Rochester, NY and Monroe County.

## Overview
- **Business Name:** Junk Removal Brothers (also known as Rochester Junk Removal Brothers)
- **Owners & Operators:** David & Michel (two brothers based in Rochester, NY)
- **Phone / SMS Photo Quotes:** 585-699-4762 (Call or text photos directly for fast quotes)
- **Email:** RocJunkRemoval@proton.me (Encrypted via Proton Mail)
- **Location:** Rochester, NY (Monroe County)
- **Scheduling:** Flexible scheduling with Evening (after 5:00 PM) and Weekend (Saturday & Sunday) pickups available at no extra charge.

## Why Customers Choose Junk Removal Brothers
- **Direct Owner Communication:** No national call centers or franchise markups—customers speak and work directly with the owners (David & Michel) from the initial text/call through cleanup.
- **Evening & Weekend Availability:** Pickups available after 5:00 PM on weekdays and all weekend so customers do not need to take time off work.
- **Transparent Ballpark Pricing:** Online price estimator provides upfront ranges before booking, and final quotes are always confirmed on-site before lifting anything.
- **Community Discounts (5% Off):** 5% discount for Senior Citizens, Military & Veterans, First Responders, Social Services Workers, and Education Workers.
- **Convenient Payments & Digital Receipts:** Accepts Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Tap to Pay, Venmo, and Cash. Receipts sent via text or email.

### Access Modifiers
- Ground Floor, Garage, or Curbside Pickup: $0 extra
- 1 Flight of Stairs: +$20

- Long Carry (>100 ft): +$20

## Accepted vs. Non-Accepted Items
- **Items We Take:** Furniture, couches, mattresses, pianos, disconnected household appliances, TVs, electronics, garage/basement/attic/estate cleanouts, yard debris, exercise equipment, and general household junk.
- **Items We Cannot Take:** Appliances still connected to water, gas, or hardwired power (must be disconnected prior to pickup), wet paint, liquid chemicals, motor oil (dried paint cans are OK), propane tanks, fuel, and hazardous materials.
